attributes.title: VMX 2027
attributes.summary:
VMX 2027 takes place January 16 to 20, 2027, in Orlando, Florida, at the OCCC. The 2027 theme is "Off the Grid". Learning tracks cover small animal, large animal, exotics, veterinary nurses and technicians, practice management and professional development, plus hands-on workshops, masterclasses and Meet the Professor luncheons that cost extra and need pre-registration.

NAVC lists more than 1,000 hours of CE across the five days and an expo hall with 800+ exhibitors. In-person registration for veterinary professionals costs $250 until October 31, 2026; prices rise on November 1. VMX Virtual ($295) runs from January 16 to March 21, 2027.
